title: lantana ukambensis
intro: Lantana ukambensis, commonly known as the Ukambani lantana or East African lantana, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lantana ukambensis are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in treating conditions like fever, pain, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
